title: Indus Valley Civilization
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🌊 Indus Valley Civilization (IVC)
blocks.intro: Also known as the Harappan Civilization. India's first urban revolution, flourishing in the Bronze Age (~2500 BCE - 1900 BCE).

blocks.heading: 1. Discovery & Chronology
bullets: First discovered in 1921 at **Harappa** by **Daya Ram Sahni** under John Marshall.
Dated via Carbon-14. Mature Phase: 2600 - 1900 BCE.

blocks.heading: 2. Town Planning & Drainage (Exhaustively Tested)
bullets: Grid System: Streets cut each other at right angles, dividing the city into rectangular blocks.

Citadel & Lower Town: Most cities were divided into a raised Citadel (west, housing public buildings, elites) and a Lower Town (east, housing commoners). Exception: **Dholavira** had three divisions (Citadel, Middle, Lower).
Drainage System: Advanced underground covered drains made of burnt bricks, with manholes/soak pits at regular intervals. House drains connected directly to main street drains.
Building Material: Standardized burnt bricks with a ratio of **4:2:1** (length:breadth:thickness).

blocks.heading: 3. Site-Wise High-Yield Facts

Meaning: "Mound of the Dead". **Great Bath**, Great Granary, Bron

Only city **without a Citadel**. Bead-making factory, inkwell, li
Only site containing actual **horse bones**. Pot burials.

blocks.heading: 4. Economy, Script & Decline
bullets: Economy: Agriculture-based (wheat, barley, cotton - first to produce cotton globally, called Sindon by Greeks). Trade with Mesopotamia (called Meluhha in cuneiform texts).

Script & Seals: Pictographic script (undeciphered). Written in **Boustrophedon** style (right-to-left, then left-to-right). Seals mostly made of **steatite** (soapstone), rectangular/square showing animals.
Decline Theories: Aryan Invasion: Mortimer Wheeler (criticised now).
Ecological Imbalance / Drying of Rivers: Sood and Agrawal, Rafique Mughal.
